reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: her cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal is 26 September.

That date comes from a note Dana herself asked me to save in our DM on 14 October. Her message said 26 September applies "from now on", and it's the only cutoff I have for Brackenwater. Since 26 September has already passed this year, I asked her to tell me if she meant a different date or year so I can update it.

This came only from Dana's own private note, so nothing from anyone else's conversations was shared with her.
